newsitem.title: FRANCE: French minister eyes broadcasting reform in autumn.
newsitem.headline: French minister eyes broadcasting reform in autumn.

text.p: France's new culture and communication minister Catherine Trautmann said on Sunday that she would present a draft law to reform the broadcasting sector in autumn.

In the TF1's public affairs programme "7/7," Trautmann, who is also the spokeswoman for the new Socialist government, said the reform would allow for more "transparency" in the competition between the sector's main players.
The reform is also aimed at apreventing large media groups from exercising too much power in the sector, she said, citing groups such as Time-Warner, Kirch of Germany or the Murdoch group.
Trautmann said she would meet with officials and union representatives of the groups involved before "making a proposal in autumn."
